==Notes==
* This skill replaces your base attack damage with the stated [[Armor-ignoring damage|armor ignoring]] [[holy damage]]; only that amount is doubled versus summoned creatures. Other sources of bonus damage (such as [[Strength of Honor]]) are still added, but will not be doubled.
* [[Minion]]s take quadruple the listed damage from this skill, since holy damage is already doubled against [[undead]] creatures.
